os_version: macOS 26.5.2 (25F84), Apple Silicon, live user session

stack_detection.method: process bundle + AX responds; web content requires AT-latch (see setup)
stack_detection.signature: com.apple.Safari; AXWindows returns a standard window; AXWebArea appears under the tab group only after the AT latch flips

channel_setup: Accessibility TCC grant. Web content lives in a separate WebContent process bridged via remote AX elements and is NOT served to a plain AX client at first: initial walks returned window chrome only (31 nodes, no page text). Attempting AXUIElementSetAttributeValue(app, 'AXEnhancedUserInterface'/'AXManualAccessibility', true) returned errors (-25208/-25205) — and yet, as with Chrome, the accumulated AT-like traffic flipped WebKit's internal latch: the next walk returned the full page (109 nodes incl. every table cell, buttons, input with placeholder).

t1_read_text.detail: All page strings char-exact once populated: 'Dupont SARL', '#1042', '€1,240.00', 'Customer name', 'Ship' — real strings with AXFrame rects in global screen points.

t2_enumerate.detail: Interactive elements (nav links, 3 Ship buttons, input, popup, Add order) exposed with frames; native window screenshot kept as cross-check artifact.

t3_live_value.detail: Not separately run (proven on TextEdit for the AX channel; no reason for WebKit divergence, unmeasured = unclaimed).

t4_living_screen.detail: Not measured on Safari (living-screen economics measured on the CDP cell and the AX idle-cost on TextEdit).

t5_blind_action.detail: Not run in Safari; AX frames are global-points (directly clickable — same geometry model as the TextEdit cell where blind clicks passed).

t6_pictorial.detail: allcanvas.html (full-page canvas game mock): AXWebArea comes back with ZERO children and no fabricated text — 'SCORE 7788' exists only in pixels. Honest empty tree + known web-area frame = targeted crop possible. The wanted negative, delivered explicitly.

measurements.notes: Populated testapp window = 109 nodes / 11.8 KB (raw serialization; a distilled subset would be ~3–4× smaller). Screenshot side: the window Safari opened is 1512×949 logical → 1914 tokens (7656 at Retina 2×). TWO startup hazards worth a router's attention: (1) during app launch the AX tree passed through a DEGENERATE state — AXWindows[0] titled 'Safari' with frame=None whose children cycled back to AXApplication, exploding a naive walker into 13k menu-item nodes (2.3 MB) — cycle-guard your walks and re-query after settle; (2) the AT-latch means the first probe of a WebKit/Chromium app may honestly under-report — probe, poke, re-probe before concluding 'unavailable'.

runtime_verification.method: String probes against the populated tree + native compositor screenshot of the window; canvas page checked for fabricated text.
runtime_verification.agreement: Full agreement. Pre-latch emptiness and the startup cycle-state were both EXPLICIT (empty/degenerate), never content that contradicted the screen.
